title: Beat Bloom
description: Hit the beat on a neon 3D highway to 20 original songs, from lo-fi Rainy Window and chiptune Pixel Hearts to 172 BPM Hyperloop and the Final Boss. Tap the four lanes or use D F J K, hold long notes, chain combos and chase S ranks on Easy, Normal and Hard. Earn stars to unlock new songs and climb the global leaderboard.
